description: Milestone 1: Alamo Square park and surrounding blocks at full detail, plus the view corridor east over the Painted Ladies to downtown and the Bay as massing, plus a coarse whole-city terrain backdrop.
howToRegenerate: cd pipeline && npm install && npm run fetch && npm run bake && npm run maps

frame.projection: transverse Mercator, central meridian -122.4194, k=1, GRS80 (shared/geo.ts)

terrain.format: gzip of int16 little-endian, centimetres NAVD88 (metres = value / 100), 257 x 257 samples, row-major; row 0 = north edge (z = z0), column 0 = west edge (x = x0); edge samples are shared with the neighbouring tile

landcover.format: gzip of uint8, 257 x 257 samples in the same layout as the heights

massingTiles.format: gzip of UTF-8 JSON; 4 km block files of 256 m tiles with the building record of tiles/, buildings only, detail "massing"
massingTiles.excludes: everything inside vectorBounds (those buildings are in tiles/)

assessorClasses.DD: 2 Dwellings on 1 Parcel 4 units or less
assessorClasses.O35: Office Portion Leased of 35 or More
assessorClasses.XV: Single Struct on Multi Lot(D & F's only)
assessorClasses.OA: Office and Apartments 4 units or less

sources.title: Building Footprints (Pictometry 2010 masses split at parcel lines; LiDAR zonal stats c. 2014-16)
Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Rolls (latest closed roll year)
San Francisco Land Use (parcel-level use square footage)
Streets - Active and Retired (street centerline network, CNN)
Sidewalk Widths (2014, per CNN and side)
Elevation Contours (city, for terrain cross-check only)
OpenStreetMap via Overpass (snapshot 2026-11-13T22:12:11Z)
sources.license: ODbL 1.0 - attribution "(c) OpenStreetMap contributors" required; derived database is share-alike

sources.title: Traffic Signals (SFMTA signal inventory, one record per signalised location)
Stop Signs (SFMTA, one record per sign with the traffic direction it stops)
Curb Ramps (Public Works inventory, intersection corners)
Stormwater inlets, drains and catch basins (SFPUC)
Assets Maintained by the Recreation and Parks Department
Historic Resource Status by Parcel (SF Planning CEQA codes)
Building Permits: new construction filed since 2005
SFPUC Streetlights (public feature service in the City and County of San Francisco ArcGIS organisation; SFPUC-owned poles only)
sources.license: City and County of San Francisco public feature service; no licence stated on the item (treated like DataSF; confirm before shipping)

sources.title: Recreation and Parks Properties (whole city, for land cover)
Urban Tree Canopy (2016), whole city, patches over 2,000 sq ft, simplified (for land cover)
OpenStreetMap natural / landuse / leisure areas over the level-4 terrain, for land cover
Registered Business Locations (active locations; trading name, industry and licence codes, location; no owner names or mailing addresses)
Addresses - Enterprise Addressing System (base addresses with their parcel)
